llm.summary: The reviewed skill artifacts are operational helper skills with disclosed use of credentials, network APIs, local config, and optional shared memory, and I found no hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts provide SRE, Axiom alerting/dashboard, Sentry, Slack, documentation, Convex, and review workflows. Some skills can query or mutate external services, but those capabilities fit their stated operational purposes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are generally task-scoped and explicit about setup, discovery, API use, credential handling, and destructive operations; delete scripts prompt for confirmation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: I did not find hidden install-time execution in the skill artifacts. Setup scripts are user-invoked and mainly check dependencies, set execute bits, or create documented config files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The Axiom/SRE-related skills use local credential files, home-directory config, network APIs, and Slack file transfer, which is sensitive but proportionate for observability and incident-response workflows.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The Axiom SRE skill creates ~/.config/axiom-sre memory/config files and can optionally sync or push org memory through a configured git repository; this persistence is disclosed and tied to the skill purpose.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to work with your observability, dashboarding, Sentry, and Slack tooling. Use least-privileged tokens, review the local config and memory paths before adding credentials, and confirm any dashboard, monitor, notifier, Slack upload, or shared-memory push before allowing it to run.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean result] expected: No advisory SkillSpector issues were supplied, and local inspection did not identify artifact-backed hidden behavior or exfiltration.
[VirusTotal clean telemetry] expected: VirusTotal reported no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this was treated as supporting telemetry, not the sole basis for the verdict.
